evidence.name: Screen field: How the media fills its area
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How the media fills its area" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How the media fills its area
sections.description: Decides how your image or video sits in its space. 'Fit' shows the whole asset but may leave blank bars around it; 'Fill' crops the edges so the area is covered with no gaps. Fill usually looks best for a clean edge-to-edge hero, just keep anything important away from the edges; choose Fit only when the entire image must stay visible.
